hook: A humanoid robot cooks a burger from start to finish, *then cleans up the kitchen*
caption:
Tau Robotics CEO Alex Koch posted uncut footage of his company's humanoid robot making him a burger, shown at 4x speed.
It turns on the stove, fries the patty, builds the burger and cleans up after itself.
The robots are not fully autonomous yet: a human operator steers them remotely with AI help.
Tau already rents them out to clean homes in San Francisco.

Would you let a robot cook your dinner?
